result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the delivery metadata under Tokumaru Ramen Bar is malformed and hard to read.

issues.description: Under “Tokumaru Ramen Bar,” the metadata line renders as “25-30delivery · Ramen,” with the time range and “delivery” colliding and no visible space or “min,” making the delivery details difficult to parse.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the time, unit, and labels as separate spaced text (e.g., “25–30 min delivery · Ramen”) and verify the spans do not overlap or omit text.
